units.source_text: 出家的藤壶母后于今年春初患病，到了三月里，病势十分沉重。

en.t: The tonsured Empress Mother Fujitsubo fell ill early this spring, and by the third month her condition had become very grave.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝行幸三条院，向母后问病。

en.t: Emperor Reizei paid an imperial visit to Sanjo-in to inquire after his mother's illness.

units.source_text: 桐壶帝驾崩之时，冷泉帝还只五岁，尚未深解世事。

en.t: When Emperor Kiritsubo passed away, Emperor Reizei was only five years old and did not yet understand the world deeply.

units.source_text: 如今母后病重，帝心异常忧虑，愁容满面。

en.t: Now that his mother was gravely ill, the Emperor was exceedingly anxious, his face full of sorrow.

units.source_text: 藤壶母后亦甚悲伤，对他言道：

en.t: The Empress Mother Fujitsubo was also deeply saddened, and said to him:
"I have long known that this year I could not escape the limit of my life.

units.source_text: 但也并不觉得特别痛苦，倘明言自知死期，深恐外人笑我故意装腔，所以并不额外多做功德。

en.t: Yet I did not feel any particular suffering; if I openly said that I knew the time of my death, I feared people would laugh at me for deliberately putting on airs, so I did not perform any extra acts of merit.

units.source_text: 我早想入宫，从容地对你谈谈当年旧事。

en.t: I had long wished to enter the palace and speak calmly with you about the events of those former years.

units.source_text: 然而少有精神舒畅的日子，以致因循蹉跎，迄未如愿，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: But there were few days when my spirits felt clear and at ease, and so I kept delaying until I still have not fulfilled that wish, which I deeply regret."
As she spoke, her voice was extremely faint.

units.source_text: 她今年三十七岁，然而还是青春盛年的模样，冷泉帝觉得非常可惜，心中更加悲伤了。

en.t: She was thirty-seven this year, yet still looked to be in the prime of youth, and Emperor Reizei felt it was a terrible pity, becoming even more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 便答道：“今年是母后应当万事谨慎小心的厄年，

en.t: He then replied, "This year is an unlucky year when Your Majesty my mother should be careful and cautious in all things,

units.source_text: 孩儿听说母后近数月来玉体违和，甚是担心。

en.t: and I heard that your august health has been poor these past several months, which worried me greatly.

units.source_text: 然而并未特别多做法事，实甚后悔。”

en.t: Yet I did not arrange especially many Buddhist rites, and I deeply regret it."

units.source_text: 他心中异常痛苦，只得在此危急之际，大规模举行法事，以祈祷母后复健。

en.t: In great anguish, he could only hold large-scale Buddhist services at this critical moment to pray for his mother's recovery.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣以前也只当作她所患的是寻常小病，不甚介意。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji, too, had previously regarded her illness as an ordinary minor ailment and had not been very concerned.
Now he too became deeply worried.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝因身份关系，未便勾留，不久告辞返宫，心中无限悲伤。

en.t: Because of the constraints of his position, Emperor Reizei could not remain there long; before long he took his leave and returned to the palace, his heart filled with boundless sorrow.
